sources.title: ADU Anaheim (three ways to approve an ADU, incl. ADU Express)
Accessory Dwelling Unit Submittal Requirements Checklist (Planning Services Division, NOV 2025, Z412)

fast_paths.name: ADU Express
rules: Only available for certain qualified single-family properties.
The homeowner selects one of the pre-approved detached ADUs in the ADU Pre-Approved Plan Catalogue, then enters an accelerated review.
Eligibility is checked with the city's ADU Express Eligibility Tool by address. The eligibility criteria themselves are not published on this page: unknown.
Review time: the ADU Anaheim page says 'within 1-3 days'; the Nov 2025 checklist says 'one day permitting'. The sources disagree; confirm with the city.

Before the accelerated review, the Pre-Approved Plan Catalogue page says to email the city your address, selected plan number and a copy of your meter spot report; staff screening to verify eligibility 'can take a few weeks'.

fast_paths.name: ADU Pre-Approved Plan Catalogue
rules: Four city-approved plans, all listed as free: Plan 001 studio 224 sf; Plan 002 1 bed 1 bath 499 sf; Plan 003 2 bed 2 bath 990 sf; Plan 004 3 bed 3 bath 1,199 sf.
Some pre-approved plans may still need a design professional to finalize the plan set (for example: site plan, Title 24, structural details, soils report); each plan set notes what else is required.
Pre-approved plans may also be used in the standard review process.

checklist.text: 1. SEWER DEFICIENCY VERIFICATION: Provide a copy of written verification from the Public Works Department verifying that there is sewer capacity to add an ADU to the property. This written verification may be obtained by submitting an email request to the Public Works Department to PWPermits@anaheim.net. Please allow up to four days to receive a reply to your email inquiry.

2. METER SPOT REPORT: Complete this step if you are adding a new electric meter, upgrading an existing meter, and/or relocating an existing meter. Request a meter sport report inspection online (Anaheim.net/3472) or by calling 714-765-6847. A utility inspector will contact you within two to three business days and provide you a copy of the meter spot report. Include the meter spot report on your building plan check submittal.

3. NEW ADDRESS REQUEST: Complete this step prior to plan submittal to avoid any time delays. Submit a completed New Address Request Application and site plan to BusinessAssistance@anaheim.net. You will be contacted via email with a link for payment on the AnaheimNext website. If submitting in-person, please arrive by 11:00 am to ensure same day processing.

1. OWNER OCCUPANCY COVENANT: AMC Section 18.38.015.110 requires the recordation of an owner occupancy covenant for all JADUs, authorized by the California Government Code Sections 65852.2 and 65852.22. The covenant for the JADU will be drafted by the City Attorney’s office and must be recorded with the Orange County Clerk-Recorder’s office prior to the issuance of a building permit. The covenant will specify the following, at a minimum: • The JADU shall not be sold or owned separately from the main dwelling and the parcel upon which the unit is located and shall not be subdivided in any manner that would authorize such sale or ownership; • Owner occupancy is required within one of the dwelling units on the property; and • Owner occupancy shall be binding upon any successor in ownership of the property. Email the following documents to your assigned project Planner as soon as possible for the City to verify current ownership of the property. The current owner(s) will be listed in the covenant and will be requested to sign covenant at the City Clerk’s office:
TITLE REPORT (Must have been prepared within the last 6 months of submittal date)
